spec.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time, temperature_c AS air_temp FROM telemetry_bme280
WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() 
AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
AND device_id = 'dev-1'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT timestamp AS time, temperature_c AS soil_temp FROM telemetry_soil_temperature 
WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() 
AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
AND device_id = 'dev-2'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT s.received_time AS time, 43 + (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(b.[key] AS INT) FROM OPENJSON(s.bins_json) b ORDER BY CAST(b.value AS FLOAT) DESC) * 43 AS [Peak Freq Hz] FROM telemetry_sound s WHERE s.received_time >= $__timeFrom() AND s.received_time <= $__timeTo() AND device_id = 'dev-1' ORDER BY s.received_time ASC

spec.description: Dominant frequency from FFT peak bin. Sourced from sensor telemetry summary (10s resolution).
spec.title: Peak Frequency (Hz)

spec.rawSql: SELECT s.received_time AS time, CAST(43 + (CAST(b.[key] AS INT) * 43) AS FLOAT) AS freq_hz, CAST(b.value AS FLOAT) AS value FROM dbo.telemetry_sound s CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(s.bins_json) b WHERE s.received_time >= $__timeFrom() AND s.received_time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY s.received_time ASC, CAST(b.[key] AS INT) ASC

spec.description: Spectrogram: X=time (received_time), Y=freq bucket (Hz), colour=magnitude. One spectrum per publish with 348 frequency buckets per timestamp.
spec.title: Sound Spectrogram

spec.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time, soil_vwc_percent AS value FROM telemetry_soil
WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() 
AND soil_vwc_percent IS NOT NULL
AND device_id = 'dev-2'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

spec.description: Volumetric water content from capacitive soil moisture sensor v2. 0% = dry, 100% = saturated.
spec.title: Substrate Moisture (VWC %)

spec.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, current_mA AS value FROM telemetry_current WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() AND device_id = 'dev-3' ORDER BY timestamp ASC

spec.description: Electrical current from current sensor. Positive = forward, negative = reverse.
spec.title: Current (mA)

spec.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, voltage_mV AS value FROM telemetry_current WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() AND device_id = 'dev-3' ORDER BY timestamp ASC

spec.description: Measurement point voltage from current sensor.
spec.title: Voltage (mV)

SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    batt_mv AS [Node 1 mV]
FROM telemetry_battery
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND batt_mv > 0
    AND device_id = 'dev-1'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

SELECT timestamp AS time, batt_mv AS [Node 2 mV] FROM telemetry_battery WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() AND batt_mv IS NOT NULL AND batt_mv > 0 AND device_id = 'dev-2' ORDER BY timestamp ASC

spec.description: Battery cell voltage for Node 1 and Node 2. Zeros excluded — only populated from dedicated battery packets.
spec.title: Battery Voltage (mV)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time, 
    as7343_405nm AS [405nm], as7343_425nm AS [425nm],
    as7343_450nm AS [450nm], as7343_475nm AS [475nm],
    as7343_515nm AS [515nm], as7343_550nm AS [550nm],
    as7343_555nm AS [555nm], as7343_600nm AS [600nm],
    as7343_640nm AS [640nm], as7343_690nm AS [690nm],
    as7343_745nm AS [745nm], as7343_855nm AS [855nm],
    as7343_visible AS [Visible]
FROM telemetry_spectrum 
WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() 
AND as7343_405nm IS NOT NULL
AND device_id = 'dev-2'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT received_time AS time, rms_dbfs AS value FROM telemetry_sound
WHERE received_time >= $__timeFrom() AND received_time <= $__timeTo()
AND device_id = 'dev-1'
ORDER BY received_time ASC

spec.description: Average sound level in dBFS from SPH0645 FFT analysis. 0 dBFS = clipping, -120 dBFS = silence.
spec.title: Sound Level (dBFS RMS)
